raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43979.

For models served by `QwenVLImageProcessor` (Qwen2-VL / Qwen2.5-VL / Qwen3-VL / Qwen3.5 / Qwen4-Exp / …), a **literal `<image>` string in ordinary message text** is counted as an image placeholder. `qwen_vl.py` registers the legacy `/generate` sentinel as an alternative inside `image_token_regex`, and the multimodal processor reuses that regex to split and count the rendered prompt. When the same request also carries a real image, the placeholder count exceeds the number of image payloads and the request aborts:

```text
Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than corresponding data provided.
Error in request: An exception occurred while loading multimodal data:
...
RuntimeError: An exception occurred while loading multimodal data:
INFO: ... "POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1" 500 Internal Server Error
```

This is easy to hit in agent workloads: GitHub issue/PR pages render user-uploaded screenshots as the literal text `<image>`, and the fetched page content is replayed as a tool message. Once such a message is in the history, **every** subsequent request to that model fails identically while any image is present — the conversation is permanently wedged (we observed 20+ consecutive 500s from a single agent session, which also tripped the gateway's circuit breaker).

The chat template only ever emits the native `<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>` placeholder, so in the chat path any bare `<image>` in the rendered prompt is user text.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py`
  - Add `neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel*` helpers, mirroring the existing Kimi K3 `neutralize_kimi_k3_image_placeholder*`.
  - Add `self.is_qwen_vl` (model-type gate, same idiom as the existing `is_gpt_oss` / `is_gemma4`).
  - In `_apply_jinja_template()`, neutralize the bare `<image>` sentinel in message text before the chat template is rendered, for the Qwen-VL family only.
  - Only *text* is rewritten: string content, `text` / `input_text` parts, and `reasoning_content` / `reasoning`. Structured `image_url` parts are untouched, so real media still renders as the template's native placeholder and media pairing is unaffected.
  - Raw `/generate` prompts are not touched, so the legacy sentinel keeps working there.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py`
  - `TestNeutralizeQwenVlImageSentinel` covers: text replacement; native placeholder untouched; string content neutralized without mutating the input; text parts neutralized while media parts are preserved; `reasoning_content`; the nested value walker; and gate membership.

Gate list (`QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES`) is the set of model types handled by `QwenVLImageProcessor`: `qwen2_vl`, `qwen2_5_vl`, `qwen3_vl`, `qwen3_vl_moe`, `qwen3_5`, `qwen3_5_moe`, `qwen4_exp`, `qwen3_omni_moe`, `intern_s2_preview`, `interns2_mobius`, `cosmos3`.

### Alternatives considered

- **Drop `<image>` from `image_token_regex` / `get_combined_regex()`**: breaks the legacy `/generate` path, where the bare sentinel is the legitimate placeholder written by the caller.
- **Neutralize globally (all models)**: unsafe — LLaVA / DeepSeek-VL2 / InternVL / … legitimately use `<image>` as a *client-written* placeholder in message text, so the gate is required.
- **Degrade the mismatch to a warning in the processor**: masks genuine pairing bugs (e.g. a client that drops image data), so it needs a flag and a separate discussion.

### Related

#37579 reports the same failure mode for the GLM-V (`glm4v`) processor with `<|image|>` / `<|video|>`. This PR only covers the Qwen-VL family; the two share the underlying "prompt split cannot distinguish template placeholders from ordinary text" issue.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable — this only rewrites prompt text for the Qwen-VL family; no kernel, model-forward, or sampling change. Covered by a CPU unit test.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable — a single `str.replace` pass over message text, gated to the Qwen-VL family.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing docs change; behavior matches the chat template's contract.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A, see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Reproduction (pre-fix)

One real image plus one message whose text contains the literal sentinel:

```python
import requests

PNG = "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="


def call(text):
    return requests.post(
        "http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/chat/completions",
        json={
            "model": "<any Qwen-VL-family model>",
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [
                        {"type": "text", "text": "what is this?"},
                        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{PNG}"}},
                    ],
                },
                {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": "c1", "content": text},
                {"role": "user", "content": "go on"},
            ],
            "max_tokens": 8,
        },
    ).status_code


print(call("plain text, no markers"))  # 200
print(call("<image>"))                 # 500 before this change
```

@@ -237,6 +237,82 @@ def neutralize_kimi_k3_image_placeholder_value(value: Any) -> Any:
     return value
 
 
+# Model types served by QwenVLImageProcessor. Its `image_token_regex` also accepts the
+# legacy bare "<image>" sentinel (see multimodal/processors/qwen_vl.py), and the
+# multimodal processor reuses that regex to split and count the rendered prompt. The chat
+# template only ever emits the native "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+# placeholder, so in the chat path a bare "<image>" in message text (e.g. fetched web
+# content, GitHub renders screenshots as "<image>") is counted as an extra image
+# placeholder and aborts the request with "Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than
+# corresponding data provided" (HTTP 500). Neutralize it in message text before
+# rendering, like the Kimi K3 handling above.
+QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES = (
+    "qwen2_vl",
+    "qwen2_5_vl",
+    "qwen3_vl",
+    "qwen3_vl_moe",
+    "qwen3_5",
+    "qwen3_5_moe",
+    "qwen4_exp",
+    "qwen3_omni_moe",
+    "intern_s2_preview",
+    "interns2_mobius",
+    "cosmos3",
+)
+QWEN_VL_IMAGE_SENTINEL = "<image>"
+QWEN_VL_IMAGE_SENTINEL_NEUTRALIZED = "< image >"
+
+
+def neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel(text: str) -> str:
+    return text.replace(QWEN_VL_IMAGE_SENTINEL, QWEN_VL_IMAGE_SENTINEL_NEUTRALIZED)
+
+
+def neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel(value)
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return [neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return {
+            key: neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value(item)
+            for key, item in value.items()
+        }
+    return value
+
+
+def neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_in_messages(
+    messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Neutralize the bare legacy "<image>" sentinel in message *text* only.
+
+    Structured media parts (``{"type": "image_url", ...}``) are left untouched, so real
+    media still renders as the template's native placeholder and pairing is unaffected.
+    """
+    neutralized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for message in messages:
+        message = dict(message)
+        content = message.get("content")
+        if isinstance(content, str):
+            message["content"] = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel(content)
+        elif isinstance(content, list):
+            parts = []
+            for part in content:
+                if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("type") in (
+                    "text",
+                    "input_text",
+                ):
+                    part = dict(part)
+                    if isinstance(part.get("text"), str):
+                        part["text"] = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel(part["text"])
+                parts.append(part)
+            message["content"] = parts
+        for key in ("reasoning_content", "reasoning"):
+            if key in message:
+                message[key] = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value(message[key])
+        neutralized.append(message)
+    return neutralized
+
+
 def _extract_video_question(request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> str | None:
     """Return text paired with a video in the last user turn."""
     for message in reversed(request.messages or []):
@@ -328,6 +404,15 @@ def __init__(
             and self.tokenizer_manager.model_config.hf_config.model_type
             in ("gemma4", "gemma4_unified")

+        # template is rendered (see QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES).
+        self.is_qwen_vl = (
+            hasattr(self.tokenizer_manager.model_config, "hf_config")
+            and hasattr(self.tokenizer_manager.model_config.hf_config, "model_type")
+            and self.tokenizer_manager.model_config.hf_config.model_type
+            in QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES

                 message, strict=self.chat_encoding_spec != "kimi_k3"
             )
 
+        # Qwen-VL family only: the multimodal processor also treats a bare "<image>" in
+        # the rendered prompt as an image placeholder, so a literal occurrence in message
+        # text would be miscounted against the real media and fail the request. Text and
+        # structured media parts are still unambiguous here, so neutralize text only.
+        if self.is_qwen_vl:

         prompt_ids = self._encode_messages(
             copy.deepcopy(messages),

@@ -34,7 +34,11 @@
     ToolChoiceFuncName,
 )
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat import (
+    QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES,
     OpenAIServingChat,
+    neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel,
+    neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_in_messages,
+    neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value,
     normalize_tool_content,
 )
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
@@ -5160,5 +5164,72 @@ def test_other_kwargs_unchanged(self):
                 )
 
 
+class TestNeutralizeQwenVlImageSentinel(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Unit tests for the Qwen-VL legacy "<image>" sentinel neutralization.
+
+    A bare "<image>" in message text must not reach the chat template: the Qwen-VL
+    multimodal processor also accepts it as a placeholder when splitting the rendered
+    prompt, so a literal occurrence would be counted against the real media and fail the
+    request with "Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than corresponding data provided".
+    """
+
+    def test_text_replacement(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel("see <image> here"), "see < image > here"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel("plain text"), "plain text")
+
+    def test_native_placeholder_untouched(self):
+        native = "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+        self.assertEqual(neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel(native), native)
+
+    def test_string_content_neutralized_without_mutating_input(self):
+        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "a <image> b"}]
+        out = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_in_messages(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(out[0]["content"], "a < image > b")
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["content"], "a <image> b")
+
+    def test_text_parts_neutralized_media_parts_preserved(self):
+        image_part = {
+            "type": "image_url",
+            "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64,AA=="},
+        }
+        messages = [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "look at <image>"}, image_part],
+            }
+        ]
+        out = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_in_messages(messages)
+        content = out[0]["content"]
+        self.assertEqual(content[0]["text"], "look at < image >")
+        self.assertEqual(content[1], image_part)
+
+    def test_reasoning_content_neutralized(self):
+        messages = [
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "content": "x",
+                "reasoning_content": "about <image>",
+            }
+        ]
+        out = neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_in_messages(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(out[0]["reasoning_content"], "about < image >")
+
+    def test_value_helper_walks_nested_structures(self):
+        value = {"a": ["<image>", {"b": "<image>"}]}
+        self.assertEqual(
+            neutralize_qwen_vl_image_sentinel_value(value),
+            {"a": ["< image >", {"b": "< image >"}]},
+        )
+
+    def test_gate_covers_qwen_vl_family_only(self):
+        self.assertIn("qwen4_exp", QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES)
+        self.assertIn("qwen3_vl", QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES)
+        # LLaVA-style models legitimately use "<image>" as a client-written placeholder.
+        self.assertNotIn("llava", QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES)
+        self.assertNotIn("internvl", QWEN_VL_MODEL_TYPES)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main(verbosity=2)
